'''Sangus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. At some point before [[3640 BBY]] he used the assets of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
